title: Restore a deleted object
summary: Deleted object recovery window and irreversible expiration.

passages.text: A deleted object can be restored for 30 days. After that recovery window it is permanently erased.
A restore operation requires the storage administrator role.

title: Restore account access
summary: Reset an account password and restore access with recovery codes.

passages.text: Recovery codes restore account access when a security key is lost.
A password reset link expires after 20 minutes.

title: Object versions
summary: Previous object revisions and version retention configuration.

passages.text: When versioning is enabled, earlier object revisions remain until a lifecycle rule removes them.
All stored object versions count toward billed storage.
